comment: The pinned orchard release. Edited only by a deliberate update, never to silence a failure. assets[] are download hashes and change when an archive is repacked; files[] are content hashes and change only when the words do. v1.1.0 changed every archive hash and no content hash. v1.8.1 denies cooly, the alternative spelling of coolie, so enable.txt and beyond-size-70.txt move; it demotes twink, twinks and karen, none in the common pool, so they move no list; dictionary-patch.tsv carries the new rows. Every other content hash is unchanged from v1.8.0. No file was added. See scripts/update-lexicon.ts.
